description: Request a rollback to a saved version of the agent settings. It restores the version's greeting, voice, prompt (and the editable prompt copy, when the version saved one), model and call summary/scoring. Transfer settings, call length, tools and speech recognition stay as they are; the result lists what was and was not restored. When the business owner or an admin is signed in through this connector, the rollback applies immediately; otherwise the owner approves it from a review link. Targets are listed by list_config_versions. The rollback is itself saved as a new version, and secrets are never copied.

actor.description: Do not set. Kept for older clients; the signed-in connection identifies you.

authority.description: Do not set. It cannot approve a change: the owner approves through review_url or by being signed in.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

dry_run.description: Validate tenant, scope, and policy without touching the live config.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this rollback; repeating it returns the first outcome. Defaults to a key from the agent, the target version and the version live now, so rolling back to the same version again after later changes works. The result returns the key used.

queue_for_approval.description: Create a durable owner-review request (default true). Setting false returns needs_approval, but an authority-envelope retry still cannot execute.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded in the audit trail.

source_ref.description: External source reference, such as a ticket or automation run ID.

version_id.description: Version id to restore, from list_config_versions. One of version_number/version_id is required.

version_number.description: Version number to restore, from list_config_versions. One of version_number/version_id is required.

name: rollback_config

result.description: On executed: { agent_id, restored_from_version, restored_fields, skipped_fields, not_restored, new_version_number, warning? }.

title: Rollback Agent Configuration
